header.name: Villager Inspector
header.description: v1.0.0 - Look at a villager to see what it is carrying: its bread and breeding food, and whether a farmer is locked to one crop.

settings.text: §lVillager Inspector§r - look at a villager and the line above your hotbar shows what it is carrying.
§7Changes here take effect the next time the world loads.§r
See villagers through glass and walls
settings.name: villager_inspector:through_blocks

settings.text: §7Breeders and farms are usually behind glass, fences or trapdoors, and any block stops the line of sight. With this on, the nearest villager you are pointing at within reach is read even if a block is in the way.§r
